quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries press release: MHI Receives Follow-up Order for 8 Two-Car Trains for (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Land Transport Authority (LTA), Singapore: MHI, jointly with its regional subsidiary Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Asia Pacific, received an order for 8 two-car trains (16 cars) of Automated Guideway Transit for the Sengkang-Punggol LRT (SPLRT). The order is part of a capacity-enhancement project awarded to MHI in January 2022 and follows a May 2023 order for 8 additional trains; MHI plans to deliver a total of 33 trainsets including the 8 in this contract. MHI Group supplied the trains and all systems when SPLRT opened in 2003, and two new trainsets of the same model began commercial operation in July 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 8 two-car trains (16 cars); 33 trainsets in total to be delivered
